title: CollectionItemV1
description: Canonical representation of a collected content item across platforms (Douyin, Bilibili, YouTube) for Downloader and Source Intake pipelines.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version. Changes must bump the version identifier.

source_type.description: Intake source channel. Strictly 'collection' (收藏), distinct from 'like' or 'history'.

platform_content_id.description: Platform-native unique content identifier (e.g. Douyin aweme_id). Immutable primary identity.

source_url.description: Permanent canonical human-accessible web URL (e.g. https://www.douyin.com/video/<aweme_id>). Never a transient CDN URL.

title.description: Explicit content title or headline if provided by creator/platform, null if omitted.

description.description: Primary textual description or caption accompanying the content.

tags.description: Normalized topics, challenges, or hashtags without '#'.

platform_author_id.description: Platform internal numeric or alphanumeric author ID (e.g. Douyin uid).

sec_uid.description: Douyin-specific security user ID used for web routing (https://www.douyin.com/user/<sec_uid>).

username.description: Public custom handle or unique ID (e.g. Douyin unique_id or short_id).

avatar_url.description: Author avatar thumbnail URL at observation time.

profile_url.description: Canonical web URL to the author's public profile.

signature.description: Author self-introduction or bio at observation time.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the author originally published the content (mapped strictly from create_time). NEVER the collection time.

first_seen_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the collector first observed this item in user's collection. Immutable across sync runs.

last_seen_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the collector most recently confirmed this item present in collection.

reappeared_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp if this item was re-favorited / reappeared at the collection head after prior ingestion, null otherwise.

active.description: True if currently confirmed present in user's collection; false if uncollected or deleted.

observed_count.description: Cumulative count of sync runs that observed this item.

last_seen_position.description: 1-based position in the collection list during the most recent observation.

cover_url.description: Best-effort primary cover image URL at observation time.

cover_asset_id.description: Platform-internal immutable cover storage key (e.g. Douyin TOS URI).

video_asset_id.description: Platform-internal immutable video stream storage key (e.g. Douyin TOS URI).

images.description: Ordered image array for image_album (图文) items, null for videos.

download_input.description: Transient signed URLs passed directly to Downloader. Volatile with short expiration; DO NOT use as permanent storage.

fetched_at.description: Timestamp when signed download URLs were extracted.

chapters.description: Structured video chapters or outline timestamps when available.

statistics.description: Public social metrics snapshot at observation time.

archive_file.description: Relative file path to the preserved raw response page archive.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the raw response page archive.

item_index.description: 0-based index of this item in the archive's aweme_list array.

raw_ref.description: Pointer to the archived raw response payload without repeating raw JSON in DB.

legacy_compatibility.description: Compatibility projection layer for legacy local-video-knowledge v1 schema.

collected_at.description: Legacy alias pointing to collection.first_seen_at. True collect time is unobservable in listcollection.
